Developer Charles S. Cohen Secures Full Construction Financing for West Palm Point Tower in Florida

30 Oct 2026, 10:24 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Business Desk · Source: www.prnewswire.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysDeveloper Charles S. Cohen has finalized the complete construction financing for West Palm Point, a new Class AA+ office tower planned for downtown West Palm Beach, Florida. Arranged by Cooper Horowitz, the $400 million project is scheduled for completion in the first quarter of 2029.

Image: Cohen Brothers Realty Corporation · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

In this article
  1. Project Scope and Specifications
  2. Location and Development Team
  3. Practical Implications and Verification

Developer Charles S. Cohen has finalized the complete construction financing for West Palm Point, a new Class AA+ office tower planned for downtown West Palm Beach, Florida. Arranged by Cooper Horowitz, the $400 million project is scheduled for completion in the first quarter of 2029.

Project Scope and Specifications

Spanning an entire city block, the 23-story tower will encompass 438,000 square feet of office space alongside ground-floor retail. Architectural planning is led by Pelli Clarke & Partners, with Nichols Architects serving as the architect of record. Design highlights include a 30-foot-high lobby, office ceilings exceeding 10 feet, energy-efficient windows, and an independent 10-story parking garage providing approximately 1,200 spaces. The development targets both LEED Gold and Fitwel certifications.

Amenities will feature a one-acre landscaped private rooftop park equipped with a putting green, a dog park, a café, an entertainment space, and a water feature designed by Fluidity. Additional tenant facilities include a fitness center, locker rooms, showers, conference facilities, on-site dining options, and creative workspace situated on the second level of the parking structure.

Location and Development Team

West Palm Point is situated near the Palm Beach County Convention Center, the Kravis Center for the Performing Arts, the Hilton hotel, CityPlace, and the Brightline rail service, with proximity to Palm Beach Island, the airport, and Interstate 95.

The development and design team includes Coastal Construction as the general contractor, EDSA for landscape architecture, AREA Architects for interior design, L'Observatoire International for lighting, Pentagram for environmental graphics, Bliss & Nyitray for structural engineering, Langan for civil and geotechnical engineering, and TLC Engineering Solutions for MEP engineering. Executive leasing is managed by John K. Criddle and Joseph Freitas of CBRE, alongside Marc Horowitz of Cohen Brothers Realty Corporation.

Practical Implications and Verification

For businesses evaluating corporate relocations or expanded footprints in South Florida, West Palm Point adds a significant Class AA+ alternative to the regional market. Prospective tenants and industry analysts can review confirmed project specifications, timelines, and development partners through the official announcement.

  • What is confirmed: The $400 million total project cost, the projected Q1 2029 completion date, the involvement of financing broker Cooper Horowitz and developer Cohen Brothers Realty Corporation, and the target LEED Gold and Fitwel sustainability certifications.
  • What is unknown: Specific lease agreements, tenant rosters, and interim construction milestones have not been detailed beyond the general timeline.
  • How to verify: Readers can review the original announcement and press details through PR Newswire.
